name: insert_row
body:
Worksheets.Add.Name = "Other"
Worksheets("Sheet1").Activate
Range("A1").Value = 10
Range("B2").Value = 20
Range("C3").Value = 30
Range("E5").Formula = "=A1+$B$2+C$3+$C3"
Range("F5").Formula = "=SUM(A1:C3)"
Range("G5").Formula = "=SUM($A$1:$C$3)"
Range("H5").Formula = "=SUM(A:C)+SUM(1:3)"
Range("E6").Formula = "=IF(TRUE,""A1:B2"",Other!A1)"
Worksheets("Other").Range("A1").Formula = "=Sheet1!$B$2"
ThisWorkbook.Names.Add "Tracked", "=Sheet1!$A$1:$C$3"
On Error Resume Next
Rows("2:2").Insert
n = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Report = CStr(n)
For Each cell In Range("A1:J9")
If cell.Formula <> "" Then Report = Report & "|" & cell.Address & ":" & cell.Formula
Next cell
Report = Report & "|Other:" & Worksheets("Other").Range("A1").Formula
Report = Report & "|Name:" & ThisWorkbook.Names("Tracked").RefersTo
